title: Kite Lane Framing | Two points from our client visits
titleZh: 風箏巷裱框工作室｜客戶拜訪的兩項觀察
passage:
Anika, the illustrator, is planning a series of small drawings that she can display in the same four frames. She likes the dark wooden borders on the frames we lent her and asked us not to make them narrower. Her problem is the card inside each frame: it has one fixed opening, and a smaller drawing slips too far behind it. The card slides out from behind the wooden border. We have spare cards without openings; the workshop cuts these after it receives the dimensions of a drawing.

She spent ten minutes trying to decide which drawing would fit which frame. ‘I want the frames to disappear from the decision,’ she said. She said she wanted the pieces in each month’s display to work as a set, not simply have something in every frame. She does not want us to trim any of the originals.

At another visit, Dara showed me two estimates for a commission. Our first email gave a lower figure for displaying a single illustration. The later estimate was higher because it also included a second window for a handwritten dedication that Dara wanted to show beside the illustration. Both figures included the same charge for the frame. Dara had read the later figure as a replacement for the first, not as the price of doing more work.

Dara said, ‘I’m not asking you to match the first number. Just make it possible for me to choose what I’m paying for.’ The handwritten dedication is still under consideration. Dara has approved the frame and wants work on the illustration to go ahead even if we do not display the dedication. No extra work on the dedication has begun.
passageZh:
插畫家安妮卡計畫讓一系列小幅圖畫輪流在同四個畫框內展示。她喜歡我們借給她的深色木框邊，也請我們不要把邊做窄。問題在於各畫框內的卡紙：卡紙只有一種固定開口，小一點的圖畫會滑到卡紙後方，無法在開口中好好展示。卡紙可從木框邊後方抽換。我們有未開口的備用卡紙，工作室收到圖畫尺寸後才會按尺寸裁出開口。

她花了十分鐘試著決定哪幅圖該配哪個框。她說：「我希望選圖時可以不用考慮畫框。」她希望每個月展出的作品能搭成一組，而不只是每個畫框裡各有一幅圖。她也不希望我們裁剪任何一幅原畫。

另一次拜訪時，達拉給我看了同一件委託的兩份估價。我們第一封電郵的金額較低，只包含展示一幅插畫。後來的估價較高，因為也包含另一個開口，用來展示達拉想附在插畫旁的手寫題詞。兩份估價所列的畫框費用相同。達拉把後來的總額理解成用後來的價格取代原估價，而不是增加工作內容後的價格。

達拉說：「我不是要你們照第一個金額收費。我只是希望自己能選擇要付錢做哪些事。」是否展示手寫題詞還在考慮中。達拉已認可畫框，希望即使不展示題詞，也開始處理那幅插畫。題詞的額外工作還沒開始。
